QuestInfo.name: Bringing Back the Brain
QuestInfo.0: Maha tells you that you've become stronger, and that it's about time for some serious training. He says you've got to get your skills back. Go find the #btraining spot#k Maha mentioned. Lilin should know something about it.
QuestInfo.1: Maha says there is somewhere on the island where you can relive past training. Lilin says he talking about the #bMirror Cave#k at the Ice Cliff.
QuestInfo.2: The Mirror of Desire helped you remember when you got Maha after passing a test from #bSir Blacksmith#k in Mu Lung. You regained some skills along with your memory.

0.msg: You should be able to find the Mirror Cave by travelling west out of the village.
